title: Register bound from the invariant
statement: Let $s,w,i$ be natural numbers, and let a state have natural-number registers $n,a,X,P,T,Z,C,s_0,w_0,K,U,V,M,I,SE,SP,E,Q$. Suppose the invariant conditions hold: $n=a=X=P=T=Z=C=Q=E=0$, $s_0=s$, $w_0=w$, $K=2^w$, $U,V<2^w$, $M\le 2^w$, $I=i$, $SE<2^{w(w-i)}$, and $SP<2^{w-i}$. If $s\le w$ and $i\le w$, then every listed register is at most $2^{w^2}$.
